title: Rav Ada of Karchina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Yevamot 10a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.10a.2) he spoke before Rav Kahana in Rava’s name. In [Sanhedrin 92a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.92a.8) he raised a difficulty against Rabbi Elazar, and Rabbi Elazar answered him; Hyman calls this a scribal error and says it should read Rav Acha of Karchina, as in Dikdukei Soferim, and so it is in [Berakhot 33a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.33a.22).[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Yevamot and Sanhedrin say Ada. The parallel objection in Berakhot says Acha. Hyman proposes Acha for Sanhedrin on the strength of his reported Dikdukei Soferim reading.
